text_block_list.text:
"With today marking the end of training 
camp, the Umamusume reluctantly board the 
bus heading back—"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Why do you try to get on the bus every 
year?! Trainer-kun isn't a bus, you know!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Why do you try to get on the bus every 
year?! Trainer-chan isn't a bus, you know!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
The training camp isn't over until we ride 
Tac-chan all the way home while catching 
the best breeze!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Come on, if we don't hurry, we'll miss the 
jump! We're gonna win by a massive margin 
on the way home, too~!

And so, our fulfilling summer training 
camp came to a (safe?) conclusion.
